def _start_server(self, display_name: str, mount_name: str, app: Any,
                      path: str, config: Any, bind_addr: Tuple[str, int],
                      ssl_info: Any,
                      mounts: Optional[Iterable[Tuple[Any, str, Any]]] = None) -> ServerAdapter:
        self.mgr.log.info(f'Starting {display_name} server on {bind_addr[0]}:{bind_addr[1]}...')

        tree = _cptree.Tree()
        tree.mount(app, path, config=config)

        if mounts:
            for mounted_app, mounted_path, mounted_config in mounts:
                tree.mount(mounted_app, mounted_path, config=mounted_config)

        adapter, _ = CherryPyMgr.mount(
            tree,
            mount_name,
            bind_addr,
            ssl_info=ssl_info
        )
        return adapter

    def run(self) -> None:

def start_servers() -> Tuple[ServerAdapter, ServerAdapter]:
            sd_port = self._service_discovery_port
            sd_ip = self.mgr.get_mgr_ip()
            sd_config, sd_ssl_info = self.service_discovery.configure(
                sd_port,
                sd_ip,
                self.security_enabled
            )
            sd_adapter = self._start_server(
                'service discovery',
                'service-discovery',
                self.service_discovery,
                "/sd",
                sd_config,
                (sd_ip, int(sd_port)),
                sd_ssl_info
            )

            agent_config, agent_ssl_info, agent_mounts, bind_addr = self.agent.configure()
            agent_adapter = self._start_server(
                'agent',
                'cephadm-agent',
                self.agent,
                "/",
                agent_config,
                bind_addr,
                agent_ssl_info,
                agent_mounts
            )
            return sd_adapter, agent_adapter
